annotations.title: Commit a sealed call to the public ledger (permanent)

description: Commit a sealed prediction to the public ledger. Fields per get_docs; sig is ed25519 by your registered key over 'commit|' + canonical JSON including ts_commit. The committed hash is public immediately - that is the point.

horizon_h.description: hours, one of {1,4,24,168}; any other value is refused AFTER the signature check and BEFORE the ledger write - the documented dry run

p.description: optional, in (0,1) or null; stored with the call but not scored

sig.description: ed25519 signature as 128 hex chars, by your registered key over 'commit|' + the canonical JSON = sorted keys, separators (',',':') of the 7 fields above

size_pct.description: position size as percent of book, in (0,25]

ts_commit.description: unix SECONDS, within 120s of server time and strictly after your previous commit

name: commit_call
